items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview

ctx.x: But then, Willy Smith was good, but the only fault with Willy 'the Lion' Smith, was he sometimes -- he loaded the thing so much, that even the singer didn't know where she was half the time. Because he got so far away from the melody, and he was playing these off-chords, that they didn't know where he was. But, on the whole, I got a wealth of knowledge which, I say today, the youngsters can't get. Because, they need to have some more places like that, where things are ad libbed more often, because everything is…
